slides.subtitle: AI-Native Developer Workflow: Using AI Tools Without Losing Control | July 22, 2026

slides.title: What this covers
slides.body: How to turn AI coding tools into a disciplined developer workflow.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: AI coding tools can move quickly, but a vague request often turns into a vague implementation.

slides.title: Main workflow
slides.body: Compare chat assistants, terminal agents, agentic IDEs, cloud agents, and project bootstrappers. Use repository instructions, specs, architecture notes, testing guidelines, and security checklists.

slides.title: What you will leave with
slides.body: Use tests and code review to keep engineering judgment in the loop.
